title: Late-Change Charge and Calendar-Day Notice — Mobile In-Home Collection Visit Terms
content:
## Terms — Specimen Collection Appointments

**Charge.** The late-change charge is the published late-cancellation fee of 40.00, posted once as an assessed late-cancellation fee on the visit being moved and rounded to the cent; a move recorded two or more calendar days before the appointment date carries no charge.

**Notice.** For a home visit the notice of a move is counted in calendar days from the date the move is recorded to the appointment date, not in hours, so a move recorded two or more calendar days before the appointment date is free whatever the clock time. The appointment date is the visit's current appointment date — the date it is being moved from.

**Formation of the charge.** The late-change charge is formed in one fixed order: the starting rate and any amount added to it are added together first; that sum is multiplied by any multiplier applied to the charge; any deduction is then subtracted from that product. The late-change charge never goes below 0.00 and is rounded to the cent only once, at the end.

## Notice and charge (hypothetical moves of a Mobile In-Home Collection Visit due on day V)

| Move recorded on | Notice in calendar days | Late-change charge |
|---|---|---|
| Day V (the appointment date itself), any hour | 0 | 40.00 |
| Day V minus 1, at 08:00 | 1 | 40.00 |
| Day V minus 1, at 23:59 | 1 | 40.00 |
| Day V minus 2, at 23:59 | 2 | None — free whatever the clock time |
| Day V minus 10 | 10 | None |

**Points of judgement.**

- The clock time of the move plays no part; only the calendar date on which the move is recorded is compared with the appointment date.
- The published late-cancellation fee is 40.00 for the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit and 0.00 for every other visit type.
